title: Second highest salary
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on employees.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT MAX(salary) AS max FROM employees WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees)

validation.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INT, name VARCHAR(50), salary INT); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1, 'A', 40000), (2, 'B', 50000), (3, 'C', 60000), (4, 'D', 70000);
